summary.description: Two to four sentences. What was checked, what is the overall picture.

nothing_found.description: true when nothing provable was found. That is a full-fledged, expected answer — findings is then empty.

coverage.description: What was actually read and what was not. Name anything unread honestly.

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from the file that supports the finding

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input/state -> wrong result. Without that it is not a finding.
